title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
description: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

title: We are behind you and that will not change, PM tells Zelensky
description: The Ukrainian president visited London in an effort to bolster support among European allies following a row with Donald Trump.

title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
description: The actor and comedian has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.

title: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
description: The Irish writer is best known for novels such as Normal People, Intermezzo and Conversations With Friends.

title: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
description: Confirming the review, the government said it was "vital to ensure travel remains accessible and that passengers are treated fairly".

title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
description: Reform says all of those people filmed by ITV are under investigation having resigned or been suspended.

title: What we know about the Pope's lung cancer diagnosis
description: The Pope is recovering in hospital after a successful surgery to remove part of his right lung.

title: Brooklyn novelty shop reeling from 'surreal' row with Kelly Clarkson over mechanical bird
description: Art of Play says its staff have been threatened after the singer complained online about how she was treated.

title: UK threatens to ban Eritreans over migrant return policy
description: The home secretary said she would not hesitate to impose measures on other countries "refusing to co-operate".
